tools.name: vet_carriers
tools.description: Verdict for 1-25 US motor carriers by USDOT or MC/MX/FF number: USDOT status and age, operating authority, liability insurance on file vs required, out-of-service orders, 24-month inspections (driver/vehicle OOS rates vs national) and crashes, with flags. Riskiest first.

tools.name: carrier_alerts
tools.description: FMCSA events in the last N days for up to 25 carriers: out-of-service orders, authority suspension notices and status changes, insurance cancellations. Empty = nothing new.

tools.name: new_carriers
tools.description: Carriers FMCSA added in the last N days (active only), filterable by state, cargo, hazmat, interstate and for-hire. Company facts only.
